card.title: IPad Pro 12.9 5th Gen Touch Screen Not Working

source.title: IPad Pro 12.9 5th Gen Touch Screen Not Working

claims.statement: iPad Pro 12.9 (5th gen) no touch: check PP15V0_TOUCH_FILT, PP15V0_TOUCH_LDO and PP15V0_TOUCH for shorts near the two BCM15957A0 controllers above the lower display connectors.
A shorted capacitor can simply be removed; a shorted IC must be replaced.

procedure: Find and remove the shorted cap, or replace the shorted IC.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
